toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'maar' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves are full clauses, so AWS 2017 requires the comma; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.na: bestaan eintlik uit twee ou woorde
toegepas.rede_vinder: A word is not two words; it consists of two, which is the intended meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'is eintlik twee ou woorde' is loose: the word is made of two parts, it is not two words.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bestaan eintlik uit' says precisely what is meant, keeps the one-versus-two contrast and adds nothing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Two coordinate adjectives before a noun are separated by a comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'groot' and 'swaar' are of equal rank before the noun, so a comma belongs between them; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma separates the relative clause's final verb from the main verb that follows.
toegepas.fout: No comma after the long relative-clause subject, so 'gesien het was' runs two verbs together.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks where the subject clause ends and makes the sentence easier to read at first sight.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans one climbs down 'teen' a ladder; 'met 'n leer' suggests carrying one.
toegepas.fout: 'met 'n leer afklim' is not the Afrikaans expression and can read as climbing down while carrying a ladder.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'teen 'n leer afklim' is the fixed expression for the same action; the protected 'in lande met televisie' stays intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Manier om te' plus infinitive is the natural Afrikaans construction.
toegepas.fout: 'manier van kommunikeer' is a stiff construction copied from English 'way of communicating'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'manier om te kommunikeer' is the natural Afrikaans form with the same meaning.

vlae.teks: Hulle kon later 'n foto daarvan sien maar nie terwyl dit gebeur nie.
vlae.rede: 'daarvan' points back to 'nuus', but a photo is of the event, not of the news; fixing it means choosing the referent, so it is flagged rather than changed.
